name: 1000 Genomes Project / IGSR (International Genome Sample Resource)

version.value: FTP data_collections include 1000G_2504_high_coverage (3,202 samples), 1000G_2504_high_coverage_SV, HGDP, HGSVC2, HGSVC3, hprc and others

scope: Phased variant call sets and sample/population metadata from the 1000 Genomes Project and related collections; IGSR hosts the data after the project ended.
mapping_methods: Call sets on GRCh37 (phase 3) and GRCh38 (high-coverage).

quantitative.summary: Genotypes and haplotypes of individual open-consent samples; frequencies derived.

licence.name: IGSR provides open data; terms of use are in the IGSR data disclaimer (not parsed)

coverage_limitations: Only about 2.5k to 3.2k individuals; limited ancestry and rare-variant resolution
Phase 3 GRCh37; GRCh38 high-coverage set is separate

reuse_decision.rationale: The existing NHGRI page gives project documentation only. Acquire the 3,202-sample population table now (links genotypes to ancestry); fetch chromosome-scale genotype files only on demand, since gnomAD/dbNSFP already carry 1000 Genomes frequencies.
